sentences.text: IPMA has issued a yellow warning for rough sea in the Faro district, from 2026-11-18 21:17 to 2026-11-20 09:00 local time.
On 2026-11-20, IPMA forecasts waves of 2.2 to 3.5 metres from NW on the Sagres coast, with sea temperature 19.1 to 19.2 °C.
On the Faro coast the same day, IPMA forecasts waves of 0.7 to 1 metres from W, with sea temperature 18.8 to 19.2 °C.
Faro today (2026-11-19) has a forecast minimum of 12.1 °C and maximum of 20.8 °C, 0% chance of rain and moderate wind from NW.
Sagres today (2026-11-19) has a forecast minimum of 11.5 °C and maximum of 19.9 °C, 0% chance of rain and moderate wind from NW.
